meta.name: Entre pasos: En busca de un sueño
meta.description: Minjae, a former swimmer, lost a leg to illness. Now a PhD student, he's built a quiet, controlled life, until Yujin, a master's student starting over after losing her way, throws it off balance. In a robotics lab, their romance turns fiery, bittersweet, and tender.

videos.title: Episodio 1
videos.overview: As Minjae seeks love, an unexpected incident reunites him with Youjin, a stranger he met before.

videos.title: Episodio 2
videos.overview: Youjin wants to go to grad school and asks Minjae for help. Will she make it into the robotics lab?

videos.title: Episodio 3
videos.overview: Feeling out of place on her first day, Youjin clashes with Sejin and finally snaps at Minjae.

videos.title: Episodio 4
videos.overview: As rumors spread that Minjae was seen with a mysterious woman, a jealous Youjin makes a bold move.

videos.title: Episodio 5
videos.overview: On a rainy night, Minjae can no longer ignore Youjin's bold feelings or his own.

videos.title: Episodio 6
videos.overview: Minjae and Youjin start a secret romance. From day one, the gap between them only grows.

videos.title: Episodio 7
videos.overview: Minjae and Youjin help Sejin pursue Subin. Youjin's test of love triggers Minjae's old insecurities.

videos.title: Episodio 8
videos.overview: Minjae defies Youseong. Sejin discovers their secret and challenges Youjin to a risky bet.

videos.title: Episodio 9
videos.overview: Youjin dismisses Minjae as a love left behind. What drove them apart?

videos.title: Episodio 10
videos.overview: Jihoon reveals his feelings for Youjin. At a welcome party, she runs into Minjae, now a professor.

videos.title: Episodio 11
videos.overview: As Minjae struggles with his lingering feelings for Youjin, she suddenly appears before him.

videos.title: Episodio 12
videos.overview: Now it is Minjae's turn to make a move. But the two must once again face their most dreaded choice.
